Name: Buffed Intro Quest
Author: 0Logophile0
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4]This mod may be for you if:
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=4]You've ever been tempted to abandon the Intro Quest because you have a godzillion NPCs to talk to;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=4]You put the Intro Quest on the lowest priority of your To-Dew list because finishing the quest is end-game;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=4]You want more than a sense of accomplishment after expending all that social energy saying 'hello' to everyone in the game;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=4]You need a little motivation to clear your Journal in-game.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=4]You (like me) are an Introvert and struggle with the social responsibility of small talk.[/size][/font]
[/list]

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/e7wntw.png[/img]﻿

[font=Tahoma][size=4]This mod grants a monetary reward for completing the Intro Quest. Players can choose from three options:

[u][b]BUFFED[/b][/u]: 10,000 shiny gollars.
[u]BUFFED UP:[/u] 50,000 sparkly shiny gollars.
[b][u]SUPERBUFFED:[/u][/b] 100,000 super shiny gollars, fresh from the mint!

Reward yourself — after completing the Intro Quest you can bask in the warm golden glow of your piles and piles of gollars, Scrooge McDuck style.

---> Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/533]Skip Intro[/url]﻿ and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11885]Skip Start[/url]﻿. If there are other compatibility concerns, please post a comment and I'll check it out.[/size][/font]



[img]https://files.catbox.moe/nb7a9g.png[/img]﻿
[font=Tahoma][size=4]
[/size][/font][list=1]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=4]Download this mod.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=4]Unzip and place it into your /Mods folder.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=4]Enjoy![/size][/font]
[/list]

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/81tf1g.png[/img]﻿
[font=Tahoma][size=4]A config.json file will be generated the first time you launch Stardew with this mod installed. You can change your configuration manually, but I strongly recommend installing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]﻿.

Choose from three reward options: Buffed, Buffed Up, or Superbuffed

RestartQuest: true or false

[u][b]If you have already started your save but have not completed the Intro Quest[/b], you MUST set this option to True (or click the box in the GMCM menu) or you will not get the reward. This will reset the Quest, which is ABSOLUTELY NECESSARY.[/u]
[/size][/font]


[img]https://files.catbox.moe/yi5k2e.png[/img]﻿

[font=Tahoma][size=4]Thanks to the lovely people in the SDV Discord server who breathed life into this idea (Kat, I'm talking to you), and to those who always support me in my modding endeavors. I wouldn't be anywhere without all of you, so thank you.

A very very special thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/aviroen/about-me?gameId=1303]Aviroen[/url]﻿, [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Spiderbuttons/about-me?gameId=1303]Button[/url]﻿, and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Lumisteria/about-me?gameId=1303]Lumisteria[/url]﻿, who helped me untangle my brain around the coding and for helping me to make the mod work for existing saves. You all are gems. ✨✨✨[/size][/font]
